entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production game prop sprite atlas for Agora, an original cozy pixel-art 2.5D game.
Generate one 1024x1024 PNG with a genuinely transparent background. EXACT regular 4 columns x 4 rows grid, each cell 256x256. No visible grid. Exactly ONE separate sprite centered in each cell, all entirely contained with at least 20px empty padding. Baseline y=232 within every cell. No text, no labels, no borders, no checkerboard.
Art: exceptionally beautiful hand-pixeled 16-bit life-simulation RPG assets, crisp pixel clusters, logical ~64px per sprite enlarged nearest-neighbor 4x. Selective colored dark outlines, restrained warm highlights at upper left, cool forest shadows, no smooth gradients, no antialiasing. Readable silhouette, exquisite deliberate texture, no uniform noise. Natural believable proportions, charming. Three-quarter FRONT VIEW facing camera south, visible top surfaces, symmetrical front-facing furniture, NOT diamond isometric. These will be upright cards in a 35-degree tilted 3D world.
Row 1 from left: (1) lush broad-crowned oak tree with rounded clustered leaves in sage olive and warm spring green, branched honey-brown trunk and visible roots; (2) tall elegant layered spruce pine in deep teal greens; (3) graceful palm tree with spreading fronds and textured trunk; (4) tropical jungle tree with rich emerald layered crown and hanging vines.
Row 2: (1) natural grey-blue boulder with angular faces, a little moss; (2) low clump of pink and cream wildflowers on green stems; (3) lush delicate fern plant; (4) two-armed desert cactus, olive green ribs and tiny warm flower.
Row 3: (1) closed wooden storage chest, honey oak, curved lid, dark iron straps and brass latch; (2) wooden carpenter workbench with vise and just a hammer; (3) wooden torch post with small bright amber flame; (4) short wooden fence section, two posts and two rails.
Row 4: (1) modern wooden office desk facing front, one dark teal monitor and keyboard on top, honest recognizable furniture; (2) matching teal upholstered office swivel chair, front view; (3) single wooden bed with cream pillow and navy-blue blanket seen three-quarter from foot; (4) wooden shipping bin with open top and reinforced corner bands.
Palette: warm ivory #f5e2b6, honey #c58d52, walnut #674735, darkest #293c39, green #698c48 #94af5b #395f42, slate #778e94, teal #386975, amber #eab95a. Add limited intermediate shades as needed. All 16 assets beautifully detailed and cohesive. Transparent everywhere outside each individual object. No ground patches or floating platform underneath, minimal contact shadow only. Original designs, not assets from any existing game.

entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Create a production character WALK ANIMATION SPRITE SHEET, original cozy pixel-art RPG adult avatar, transparent background, exactly 1024x1024 pixels, regular 4 columns by 4 rows of 256x256 cells. Each cell contains the SAME person, full body, centered horizontally at x=128, feet baseline y=228. Every figure exactly the same scale, about 96px wide and 176px tall, with plenty of transparent padding. No text, no lines, no checkerboard.
Character: warm medium skin, short tousled chestnut hair, small kind face with pixel eyes, teal long-sleeve shirt/jacket with ochre collar, dark navy trousers, brown boots. Adult proportions with head around a quarter of body height, NO enormous chibi head, NO white sticker outline. Consistent outfit, colors, body and facial proportions in ALL cells.
EXACT order:
Row 1 all face DOWN toward viewer: column1 neutral standing; column2 left foot steps forward and right arm forward; column3 neutral standing; column4 right foot forward and left arm forward.
Row 2 all face LEFT, full left profile: col1 neutral; col2 left leg forward; col3 neutral; col4 right leg forward.
Row 3 all face RIGHT, full right profile: col1 neutral; col2 left leg forward; col3 neutral; col4 right leg forward.
Row 4 all face UP away from viewer showing back of hair, shirt and boots: col1 neutral; col2 left step; col3 neutral; col4 right step.
Art quality: exquisite deliberate 16-bit pixel art, logically 24px wide by 44px tall character, uniformly enlarged 4x nearest neighbor. Beautiful clustered shading, dark colored selective 1 logical pixel outline, warm top-left light, cool shaded fabric folds, readable hair locks, 4-shade material ramps. Hard pixel edges with no blur, no anti-aliasing, no smooth vector curves. Flat front-facing 3/4 RPG view, not diamond isometric. No floor patches, shadows, props, weapons, hats, white border or background. Original avatar for Agora.

Agora tree growth — 12 original juvenile tree sprites
entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent tree-growth sprite atlas for original cozy pixel-art 2.5D game Agora.
Input image role: style reference ONLY, the existing approved prop atlas. Generate a NEW atlas of juvenile trees matching its beautiful clustered pixel shading and warm upper-left light. Do not redraw furniture or mature trees.
Exactly 4 columns by 3 rows, 12 separated sprites, wide transparent gutters, no text or grid. Columns species: oak; spruce; palm; jungle broadleaf with vines. Rows distinct developmental stages: ROW 1 tiny newly emerged seedling with 2-5 species-appropriate leaves and a short tender stem (palm emerging from split seed); ROW 2 sapling with thin woody stem, few branching leaves (spruce several young needle whorls, palm 3 little fronds, jungle broad leaves); ROW 3 young tree with visibly branching small canopy and narrow trunk (spruce tiers, palm arching fronds short slender trunk, jungle first hanging vine). These are genuinely different botanically readable growth silhouettes, NOT scaled-down mature trees. One isolated plant per cell, all at same baseline near cell bottom with at least 25 pixels clear padding, never touch another cell. Use available cell area for detailed rendering, world scale will be set in engine. Rectangular atlas 4:3 aspect ratio if possible.
Art style: detailed deliberate 16-bit pixel clusters, hard pixel edges, original designs, warm honey trunks, olive/sage oak leaves, deep teal spruce, emerald jungle, yellow-green palm. Match reference texture density. No white sticker outlines, no painted cast shadows, no ground discs or platforms, no background or baked checkerboard. Genuinely transparent alpha outside every plant.

entries.title: Agora axis-aligned bed orientations
entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Original cozy 16-bit pixel art bed sprite atlas, transparent background. Exactly TWO sprites side by side, 2 equal cells, no other objects, no labels or text. Same honey oak single bed with cream pillow and dark navy blue blanket as approved Agora art. Left: bed length runs exactly NORTH-SOUTH, headboard at TOP, footboard at BOTTOM, front view showing blanket top and front footboard. PERFECTLY VERTICAL CENTERLINE, left and right long edges run straight vertically on the image, absolutely no diagonal or isometric skew. Right: same bed rotated to EAST-WEST, headboard at LEFT, footboard at RIGHT; PERFECTLY HORIZONTAL CENTERLINE, long rails run straight horizontally. Show mattress upper surface as a rectangle, with front-facing vertical wooden side. Camera 35 degrees above ground, NO camera yaw; all edges align with horizontal or vertical image axes, no diamond-shaped top, no diagonal vanishing lines. Thick honest wooden posts, pixel-cluster textile folds, four legs on ground, crisp selective dark colored outline, warm top-left highlights, sage/slate cool shadows. Same construction and colors both views. High quality deliberate pixel clusters, no white border, no smooth vector shapes. Large transparent gutters, each entire object contained in its half, no baked ground or shadow. Original art, logical ~96px sprite enlarged nearest-neighbor.

entries.title: Agora bird, butterfly and torch animation atlas
entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset: original cozy pixel-art game ANIMATION SPRITE ATLAS with true transparent background. Exact 4 columns x 3 rows, twelve separated cells, no grid or text. Match warm honey wood, forest greens, teal and cream palette, deliberate crisp pixel clusters, logical sprite resolution 32-64 pixels enlarged nearest neighbor, no smooth shapes, no white sticker outline. ALL frames stay fully inside their cell, generous transparent padding.
ROW 1: SAME small charming brown woodland bird with cream belly, ochre beak, dark eye, always facing RIGHT. Frame1 perching, closed wing, feet beneath; frame2 flying with wings raised UP; frame3 flying with wings DOWN; frame4 on ground bending head DOWN with beak near feet to peck. Same bird size and body dimensions in all four, coherent sprite animation. Not a huge raptor.
ROW 2: SAME small golden-orange butterfly with dark brown wing edges, tiny pale spots, dark slim body. Four flapping phases: wings spread open; wings half open; wings closed narrow; wings half open. Face mostly viewer, identical scale and center across four cells.
ROW 3: SAME upright honey-brown wooden torch post with dark iron basket and orange-yellow fire. Four different flickering FLAME shapes, bending slightly left, taller, bending right, shorter. Wooden pole and iron basket are IDENTICAL and fixed in exactly same position and scale across all four cells; only flames change. Pole base on same baseline near bottom of cell. No painted light halo or cast shadows. Full torch visible, from flame tip to wooden foot.
Transparent outside all subjects, no environment, no labels, no ground patches, no black background, no checkerboard. Original sprites for Agora.

entries.title: Agora crop growth — radish, kale and pea, five stages each
entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original cozy pixel-art crop growth sprite atlas for Agora.
Input reference: approved Agora scene, STYLE REFERENCE ONLY for pixel density, clustered shading and palette. Do not reproduce the scene. Create a new isolated crop atlas with true transparent background.
EXACTLY 5 COLUMNS x 3 ROWS, 15 individual sprites, regular equal cells, generous transparent gutters. Landscape aspect 5:3. No labels, no text, no borders or grid.
Each ROW shows ONE species through FIVE genuinely different growth stages, left to right. Keep a common soil-line baseline near cell bottom; mature plants largest, sprouts naturally much smaller. Upright 3/4 front view, camera looks down 35 degrees, no isometric diagonal.
ROW 1 DAWN RADISH: 1 tiny two-cotyledon sprout; 2 four small fresh leaves; 3 leafy young rosette; 4 lush serrated foliage with tiny rosy root shoulder at base; 5 harvest-ready round crimson radish bulb partially above soil line, cream root tip, lush broad irregular leaves with readable pale veins.
ROW 2 MEADOW KALE: 1 two tiny rounded cotyledons; 2 four crinkly leaves; 3 small ruffled rosette; 4 medium sprawling blue-green kale; 5 magnificent mature low rosette with overlapping curled scalloped leaves, dark teal folds, sage and lime edges, visibly different leaf lobes, NOT cabbage sphere.
ROW 3 HONEY PEA: 1 two tiny pea leaves on short stalk; 2 upright tender branching seedling; 3 taller self-supporting curling tendril vine with paired oval leaflets; 4 mature leafy vine with a few ivory blossoms; 5 upright arching pea vine laden with plump golden-green pods, paired leaves and curly tendrils, small cream blossoms. NO trellis, pots or sticks.
Beautiful deliberate high quality pixel clusters, original 16-bit farming RPG art with rich natural texture, selective dark olive outlines, warm upper-left sunlight, shaded teal greens. Mature each crop logical ~64x80px enlarged nearest neighbor. Crisp square pixels, no blur or smooth vector shapes. Keep species silhouettes readable at small in-game size, avoid thin noisy dithering. Soft sage #94af5b, olive #698c48, teal shadows #395f42, pale leaf veins #c3d183, radish #c65464, ivory #f5e2b6.
NO ground discs, NO dirt patches, NO shadows, NO white sticker outlines, NO background or checkerboard. Alpha transparent outside plants. Leave root tips short: vegetables remain planted, not lifted out of ground. All sprites fully contained within own cell and separated.
